description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Cast Diabolic Tutor by paying {2}{B}{B}, searching your library for Seasons Past and put into your hand.
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Diabolic Tutor and Capture of Jingzhou to your hand and putting Seasons Past to the bottom of your library.
Repeat.
